derivation: DERIVED, not captured from COBOL. PORTTRAN.cbl cannot be compiled in this repo: it copies a PORTREC copybook that does not exist in src/copybook and references PORT-TOTAL-UNITS / PORT-TOTAL-COST, which no copybook in this repo defines. The expected result below is derived from the code paths that PORTTRAN.cbl actually executes: 0000-MAIN performs 1000-INITIALIZE, then 2000-PROCESS-TRANSACTIONS until end of file or WS-ERROR-COUNT > 100, then 3000-TERMINATE. 2000-PROCESS-TRANSACTIONS reads one transaction, adds 1 to WS-READ-COUNT and performs 2100-VALIDATE-TRANSACTION, which performs 2110-CHECK-PORTFOLIO / 2120-CHECK-TRANSACTION-TYPE / 2130-CHECK-AMOUNTS and then adds 1 to WS-PROCESS-COUNT when ERR-TEXT is still SPACES, else performs 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE which adds 1 to WS-ERROR-COUNT. Nothing in the program performs 2200-UPDATE-POSITIONS, so the buy / sell / transfer / fee paragraphs, the insufficient units check and the AUDPROC audit trail are unreachable dead code: the portfolio file is opened I-O but never rewritten, so the final state equals the seed state.
